title: Bind alpha validation notes to evidence metadata
summary: Alpha bundle validation should reject validation.md when its generated timestamp, candidate commit, branch, dirty count, readiness state, or status diverges from evidence.json.
expectedFailureModes: validation.md names a different candidate commit than evidence.json but still validates.
validation.md marks a blocked readiness report as ready but still validates.
validation.md status diverges from the recorded decision but still validates.
humanEscalation: Published bundle format changes require human approval once real public release evidence exists.
nextAction: Validate top-level validation.md metadata against evidence.json, add mismatch regression coverage, and document the metadata binding contract.
